rationale: The HUD reads heliocentricKms.toFixed(2), which the page-level $derived at line 952 wires to flyHeliocentricSpeed(scR, (R_EARTH_AU + R_MARS_AU)/2). For outer planets, scR (e.g. Jupiter ≈5.2 AU) makes the vis-viva radicand (2/r − 1/a) negative, so Math.sqrt returns NaN; the failure-mode patch likely defended against NaN inside the pure fly-physics helper rather than fixing the hardcoded Mars-Earth transfer semi-major that is the actual cause. The fix belongs at the $derived: replace R_MARS_AU with DESTINATIONS[activeDestination].a so each destination uses its own perihelion-aphelion a.
